items.title: Canadian Pacific Reaches New August Milestone for Grain Shipments
items.summary: CP's record August grain shipments, driven by strong export demand and network efficiency, mark a solid start to the 2026-2027 Canadian crop year.

items.title: Canadian National Reports Robust Grain Performance Record in August
items.summary: CNI has set an August grain record of 2.50 MMT, as network efficiency and added capacity support a strong start to the 2026-2027 crop year.

Diluted earnings per share jumped 51% to $2.03, net earnings rose 45% to $266 million, and revenue climbed 32% to $3.5 billion. items.title: Volaris Reports Decrease in Consolidated Load Factor for August
items.summary: VLRS saw August traffic rise 15.4% year over year, while capacity grew 15.8%, pushing consolidated load factor down 0.3 points to 84.4%.
